purpose: Review a finite issuer intellectual-property licensing, technology-transfer, royalty, critical inbound-license, cross-license, patent-pool and standards-essential-right lifecycle domain before opening source rows, agreements, filing values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.supply_chain_boundary: Campaign163 freezes customer, supplier, order and procurement disclosure. A commercial counterparty may also be a licensee, but ordinary customer or supplier identity does not establish intellectual-property ownership, licensed rights, field, territory, exclusivity, royalty, sublicensing or termination.
repository_evidence.operating_milestone_boundary: Campaign167 freezes patent grant, R&D and product milestones. Patent existence or grant is not an executed outbound or inbound license, technology transfer, royalty obligation, cross-license, patent-pool participation or commercialization dependency.
repository_evidence.pricing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes product prices, tariffs and sales terms. A royalty rate or license fee is one contract term, but product pricing does not identify the licensed right, licensor, licensee, territory, field of use, exclusivity, term, audit, dispute or reversion chain.
repository_evidence.enterprise_ma_boundary: Campaign177 freezes acquisitions and control transfer. Intellectual property may move in a deal, but purchase consideration and control transfer do not prove a separate license, continuing rights, retained ownership, sublicense, royalty, change-of-control consent or termination.
repository_evidence.operating_right_boundary: Campaign179 freezes public-law operating licenses and concessions. A private IP license grants contractual use of intangible rights, not statutory permission to conduct a regulated business; the authority, holder, territory and enforcement chains are different.
repository_evidence.accounting_boundary: Intangible-asset carrying value, amortization, impairment, capitalized R&D or royalty expense cannot be renamed as agreement-level commercialization or dependency state without ownership, agreement, right, counterparty, term, payment and revision history.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current patent owner, current license list or latest royalty note cannot be projected backward without agreement execution, effective date, amendment, milestone, renewal, sublicense, assignment, dispute, termination, reversion, correction and first-public histories.

right identity, jurisdiction, application and grant number, family, claims or technical scope, version, continuation, division, priority, validity, opposition, maintenance, expiry and encumbrance semantics

exclusive, sole and nonexclusive grant, field of use, product, indication, channel, territory, customer, duration, renewal, option, reservation of rights, retained use, sublicensing, assignment and change-of-control semantics

upfront fee, milestone payment, running royalty, tier, sales or profit base, minimum annual royalty, minimum guarantee, cap, floor, credit, recoupment, currency, tax, audit and payment schedule semantics

infringement, validity, ownership, royalty audit, underpayment, breach, cure, indemnity, injunction, settlement, compulsory license, termination, step-in, source-code escrow and reversion outcome semantics
